# Fully Synthetic Academic Presentation Fixture

This file contains no real patient, participant, institution, investigator, or
clinical result. Every value exists only to test the local workflow.

## Background

The synthetic exercise evaluates whether a presentation pipeline can preserve
source provenance while producing an editable deck.

## Scientific question

Can a deterministic local workflow register exact synthetic values, avoid
unsupported conclusions, and render a readable academic presentation?

## Study design

This is a software-validation fixture, not a clinical or observational study.
The two named strategies are fictional labels.
